svg.title: pos-extension
svg.desc: Context extension divides each RoPE frequency by a per-pair factor. For gpt-oss (d_h = 64, b = 150K, trained at 4,096, extended to 131,072, s = 32): PI divides all 32 pairs by 32; NTK-aware rises smoothly from 1 to 32; YaRN keeps pairs 0-8 (wavelength under 128 tokens), ramps pairs 9-17 and divides pairs 18-31 by 32. Llama 3.1 llama3 scaling (s = 8) keeps 29 pairs, blends 6 and divides 29. YaRN also multiplies logits by (0.1 ln s + 1)^2: 1.30 for s = 4, 1.46 for 8, 1.81 for 32, 1.87 for 40; llama3 type uses 1.
